warm_memory.goal: Optimize project config dropdown autocompletion, unify project name format, and reconstruct brain health telemetry console to a table on collaborative kanban dashboard.
warm_memory.classification: coding.complex; frontend visual dashboard refactor and configuration data alignment
constraints: Use design-taste guidelines for visual layouts and align styles to Dark Tech aesthetics.
Unify project format to ProjectNumber-ProjectName-CarModel (Key) everywhere.
Stage and commit only intentional source modifications, leaving unrelated temp files unstaged.
decisions: Relocated telemetry console out of Demand Kanban to Collaborative Kanban dashboard above Deconstructor.
Designed ProjectHealthTelemetry using a table structure with progress bars and expandable rows for AI diagnosis logs.
Built active project key-to-name lookup (jiraProjectMap) from /api/agenda/summary on ProjectConfig mount.
Enabled Key dropdown list autocomplete in config to autofill Name and Key inputs upon selecting a item.
findings: The raw telemetry labels from backend already carry the structured project name.
Caching key-to-name descriptions in Svelte reactive mapping resolves legacy configuration key records dynamically without database schema migrations.
validation: npm run build: passed successfully without typescript or svelte compile issues.
warm_memory.next: Deliver final status to the user and prompt verification.
